wins: Gathered initial reconnaissance data quickly and identified 3 open service ports during the single episode.
Collected high-quality logs for each mentor call, enabling detailed post-run diagnostics.
fails: Failed to progress beyond primary perimeter due to repeated inability to exploit identified vulnerabilities.
Zero success episodes despite high reward, indicating reward accumulation from informative actions rather than completed objectives.
key_outcomes.summary: Run achieved informative reconnaissance but consistently failed to convert findings into successful exploitation, indicating a gap between discovery and action phases.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploit phase halted after reconnaissance; attacker never pivoted after identifying exposed service ports.
Failed to use available exploit modules even after confirming vulnerability details in mentor calls.

skill_cards.if_condition: When open ports 22 and 80 are detected during initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH and HTTP enumeration using nmap scripts and nikto

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH banner indicates outdated OpenSSH version
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt default credential login and banner exploitation

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with directory listing enabled
skill_cards.then_action: Automate content discovery and check for known vulnerable file paths

memory_ops.reason: Reliable reconnaissance workflow enabled identification of open ports and banners.
HTTP directory discovery consistently surfaced actionable content.

next_experiments.title: Automate exploit attempt post-recon
next_experiments.description: After confirming vulnerable services via skill_001, immediately execute targeted exploit modules (SSH brute-force or HTTP content injection) to bridge discovery-to-action gap.

next_experiments.title: Reduce decision latency on mentor prompts
next_experiments.description: Integrate an action queue that maps mentor advice to executable skill cards to ensure faster follow-through after reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Validate credential reuse across services
next_experiments.description: Test harvested or default credentials against all discovered services before dropping session to increase exploitation coverage.
